To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the photocatalytic activity of polyaniline was enhanced by doping with SrTiO 3 nanocubes.
polyaniline-based nanocomposites damped with SrTiO₃ nanocubes were synthesized and their photocatalytic activity was examined for the degradation of methylene dye blue under visible light.

the photocatalytic activity of the SrTiO3 doped polyaniline nanocomposite photocatlysts is significantly enhanced compared to the pure PANI photocatalysts, and that the nanocomposites doted with 50 wt% SrTiO3 are found to be optimum for the degradation of methylene dye under solar light.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the synthesis of polyanine-based photocatalysts doped with SrO nanocubes for the degradation of MB dye, which is an important step toward the development of a new class of photocatalysts for the removal of pollutants from wastewater.
the preparation of polyaniline-based nanocomposite photocathodes with high photocatalytic activities for the degradation of methylene-blue dye under visible light irradiations.
the synthesis of a new photocatalyst that can be used for the degradation of dyes under visible light irradiance.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the photocatalytic performance of the polyaniline-based nanocomposites dopped with SrTiO 3 nanocubes can be enhanced by controlling the weight ratio of the polyanilines to the SrTiO ₃ nanocubes.
the polyaniline-based photocatalyst doped with Sr-TiO3 nanocube has a high potential for use in wastewater treatment.
the polyaniline-SrTiO3 nanocomposite photocatlysts are highly effective in the degradation of MB dye.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the photocatalyst P-Sr500 can be used for the photocatalysis of organic pollutants in wastewater treatment.
the photocatalytic activity of PANI/SrTiO3 nanocomposites was enhanced by doping SrTiO3 into polyaniline, which is a promising material for the photocatalysis of dye pollutants.
the photocatalytic activity of the prepared nanocomposites can be enhanced by doping SrTiO3.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the photocatalyst P-Sr500 has great potential for the degradation of organic pollutants.
SrTiO3-doped polyaniline is a potential photocatalyst for use in the removal of organic pollutants in wastewater treatment.
the nanocomposites dopped with SrTiO₃ nanocubes are a promising photocatalyst for the degradation of organic compounds.
